summary: Verified all 6 salon-vs-restaurant leak fixes end-to-end. Backend QR-poster endpoint returns 200 PNG for both tenants (server forces bistro design for restaurants, blush for salons). Frontend fixes for Offer Maker (Shop-Front Poster Studio), Hire Staff roles (Chef-first restaurant list), AI Assistant greeting/subtitle/chips, Gallery placeholder and Settings QR poster (single Warm Bistro chip + working preview) all work correctly on the RESTAURANT tenant. Salon regression is clean: AI Flyer Studio + templates + Generate flyer button restored; salon-assistant greeting; Hair Stylist default with salon roles; 4-design QR poster grid (Blush & Gold / Rose Gold Silk / Lavender Glam / Boho Ivory). Note: review request used /offer-maker and /hire-staff paths but the actual routes are /offers-studio and /hire (AppLayout.jsx line 41, App.js line 285). All checks pass on the real routes.

critical_code_review_comments: HireStaff.jsx L29 sets initial form.role from `resto` at first render, but tenant loads asynchronously via useAuth; when tenant is momentarily null the default is 'Hair Stylist'. It happens to be overwritten by the select's default option render, but consider syncing form.role via useEffect when tenant.business_type resolves for safety.

Restaurant tenant paths differ from review-request spec — /offer-maker and /hire-staff do not exist and silently fall back to /dashboard (route not defined). Confirmed real routes are /offers-studio and /hire (AppLayout.jsx sidebar links use these). No redirect/404 shown to users — they land on Dashboard, which is confusing.

Salon leaks are still pervasive on shared components (Dashboard, Settings, sidebar). Consider a central i18n/business_type helper (e.g., `useBusinessCopy()`) so every 'salon' string is derived from tenant.business_type instead of scattered ternaries.
